stem:
Kavya presses a lump of wet clay and a glass marble, then gently scratches each. Soft materials change shape or scratch easily; hard materials resist both.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The wet clay is soft because it changes shape easily under her press.
The glass marble is hard because it resists being scratched.
The wet clay is hard because it only dented after a firm press.
The glass marble is soft and the wet clay is hard.

teacher.key_rationale: Wet clay changes shape easily so it is soft; the glass marble resists scratching so it is hard. Calling clay hard after a firm press omits the easy-change rule; swapping soft and hard reverses the judgement.
